framework.name: BSI IT-Grundschutz Kompendium
framework.publisher: Bundesamt fuer Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik (BSI)
framework.description: BSI IT-Grundschutz Kompendium — modular security building blocks (Bausteine) for information security management. Basis for IT-Grundschutz certification recognised as equivalent to ISO 27001 by BSI. Organised in 10 layers.

objects.title: Security Management
objects.description: Information security management system requirements, strategy, and governance.

objects.title: Organisation and Personnel
objects.description: Organisational structures, roles, responsibilities, and personnel security.

objects.title: Concepts and Approaches
objects.description: Security concepts including cryptography, data backup, and software development.

objects.title: Operation
objects.description: Operational security: IT administration, patch management, malware protection, logging.

objects.title: Detection and Reaction
objects.description: Detection of security incidents and reactive measures including forensics and BCM.

objects.title: Infrastructure
objects.description: Physical and environmental security: buildings, data centres, cabling.

objects.title: Networks
objects.description: Network architecture, management, wireless, firewall, and VPN.

objects.title: IT Systems
objects.description: Secure operation of servers, clients, mobile devices, and storage media.

objects.title: Applications
objects.description: Security requirements for applications, web services, and software.

objects.title: Industrial IT
objects.description: Security for industrial control systems (ICS) and process environments.

objects.title: Security Management
objects.description: Establishment and operation of an information security management system. Covers ISMS scope, security policy, roles, management review, and continual improvement.

objects.title: Information Security Strategy
objects.description: Development and maintenance of an information security strategy aligned to organisational objectives and risk appetite.

objects.title: Organisation
objects.description: Organisational framework for information security: roles, responsibilities, authority, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

objects.title: Personnel
objects.description: Personnel security covering pre-employment screening, employment terms, disciplinary processes, and termination of employment.

objects.title: Sensitisation and Training
objects.description: Awareness, education, and training programmes to build information security competence across the organisation.

objects.title: Identity and Permission Management
objects.description: Management of user identities, access rights, and privilege administration including provisioning and deprovisioning.

objects.title: Cryptography
objects.description: Policy and technical controls for cryptographic mechanisms: key management, algorithm selection, certificate lifecycle.

objects.title: Data Backup Concept
objects.description: Conceptual requirements for data backup: objectives, responsibilities, backup classes, and recovery targets.

objects.title: Data Backup Policy
objects.description: Operational data backup policy: schedules, media, retention periods, off-site storage, and restore testing.

objects.title: Delete and Destroy
objects.description: Secure deletion and physical destruction of data carriers and information to prevent unauthorised recovery.

objects.title: Software Development
objects.description: Security requirements for in-house and commissioned software development across the full SDLC.

objects.title: Development of Web Applications
objects.description: Specific security requirements for the development and operation of web applications and web services.

objects.title: Quantum Cryptography
objects.description: Post-quantum cryptographic algorithms and migration planning to ensure long-term confidentiality.

objects.title: General IT Operations
objects.description: Baseline operational procedures: change management, operational documentation, monitoring, and standard operating processes.

objects.title: IT Administration
objects.description: Privileged account management, administrative access controls, separation of administrative and user functions.

objects.title: Patch and Change Management
objects.description: Systematic identification, evaluation, testing, and deployment of patches and software updates across all systems.

objects.title: Protection against Malware
objects.description: Anti-malware controls including detection software, scanning policies, update mechanisms, and incident response for malware.

objects.title: Logging
objects.description: Security and system logging: log generation, protection, retention, and review to support incident detection and forensics.

objects.title: Software Tests and Approvals
objects.description: Testing and formal approval of software before production deployment including security and functional acceptance criteria.

objects.title: Archiving
objects.description: Long-term preservation of records and information: archiving procedures, media management, integrity checks, and access controls.

objects.title: Remote Maintenance
objects.description: Controls for remote access used in system maintenance: authentication, encryption, session monitoring, and approval processes.

objects.title: Cloud Usage
objects.description: Governance and security requirements when using cloud services: provider assessment, contractual requirements, and data protection.

objects.title: Outsourcing to Third Parties
objects.description: Security requirements for outsourced services: risk assessment, contractual obligations, monitoring, and exit planning.

objects.title: Outsourcing Provider
objects.description: Security obligations for organisations acting as outsourcing providers: service delivery, client data protection, and audit rights.

objects.title: Detecting Security Events
objects.description: Detection controls for security events: monitoring, alerting, intrusion detection, and log analysis capabilities.

objects.title: Incident Handling
objects.description: Security incident management process: detection, reporting, classification, response, containment, and post-incident review.

objects.title: IT Forensics
objects.description: Forensic investigation procedures: evidence preservation, chain of custody, forensic analysis, and reporting.

objects.title: Cleanup after Incidents
objects.description: Recovery and cleanup procedures following security incidents: system restoration, verification, and lessons learned.

objects.title: Audits and Revision
objects.description: Internal and external audit planning, execution, reporting, and follow-up to verify security control effectiveness.

objects.title: Emergency Management (BCM)
objects.description: Business continuity management: BIA, BCP, emergency plans, crisis communication, testing, and exercises.

objects.title: General Building
objects.description: Physical security of buildings: perimeter, access controls, visitor management, security zones, and environmental protection.

objects.title: Data Centre and Server Room
objects.description: Physical and environmental controls for data centres and server rooms: access, power, cooling, fire suppression, and monitoring.

objects.title: Room and Cabinet Protection
objects.description: Security measures for technical rooms and equipment cabinets: locking, access logging, environmental monitoring.

objects.title: Storage Media Archives
objects.description: Secure storage of data carriers and archives: physical protection, climate control, access restrictions, and inventory management.

objects.title: Office Environments
objects.description: Security measures for office spaces including clean desk policy, remote working, and visitor access.

objects.title: Network Architecture and Design
objects.description: Secure network architecture principles: segmentation, DMZ design, routing, and network documentation.

objects.title: Network Management
objects.description: Network management security: privileged access, configuration management, monitoring, and change control for network components.

objects.title: WLAN Usage
objects.description: Security requirements for wireless LAN usage: authentication, encryption, rogue AP detection, and guest network segregation.

objects.title: Firewall
objects.description: Firewall policy, rule management, zone separation, logging, and regular rule-set review for perimeter and internal firewalls.

objects.title: VPN
objects.description: VPN security: authentication, encryption standards, client configuration, split tunnelling policy, and monitoring.

objects.title: General Server
objects.description: Baseline hardening and secure operation of servers: OS hardening, service minimisation, patch management, and monitoring.

objects.title: Linux and Unix Server
objects.description: Linux/Unix-specific hardening: user and group management, PAM, mandatory access controls, and secure boot.

objects.title: Containerisation
objects.description: Security requirements for container deployments: image management, runtime isolation, network policies, and secrets management.

objects.title: General Clients
objects.description: Secure configuration and operation of client systems: OS hardening, application whitelisting, endpoint protection.

objects.title: Smartphones and Tablets
objects.description: Mobile device management: MDM/UEM, remote wipe, application controls, encryption, and BYOD policy.

objects.title: Printers and Multifunction Devices
objects.description: Security for printers and MFDs: network isolation, access controls, secure print release, and data remanence.

objects.title: Removable Storage Media
objects.description: Controls for removable storage media: authorised media list, encryption requirements, scanning, and disposal.

objects.title: Office Products
objects.description: Security configuration of office productivity suites: macro controls, auto-update, protected view, and document security.

objects.title: General Directory Services
objects.description: Security requirements for directory services (LDAP/AD): authentication, replication, privileged group management, and auditing.

objects.title: Web Applications and Services
objects.description: Security controls for web applications and APIs: authentication, authorisation, input validation, and session management.

objects.title: Web Server
objects.description: Secure configuration and hardening of web servers: TLS, HTTP security headers, directory listings, and access logging.

objects.title: File Server
objects.description: Security for file servers: access controls, quotas, antivirus, auditing, and backup integration.

objects.title: General Email Clients and Server
objects.description: Email security: anti-spam, anti-phishing, S/MIME or PGP, DKIM/DMARC/SPF, and secure client configuration.

objects.title: General Software
objects.description: Lifecycle security for commercial and open-source software: procurement, testing, deployment, and end-of-life management.

objects.title: Development and Ops (DevOps)
objects.description: Security integration in DevOps pipelines: SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secrets management, and secure CI/CD.

objects.title: Process Control Systems
objects.description: Security governance for industrial control systems: ICS security policy, risk management, and zone model.

objects.title: General ICS Components
objects.description: Baseline security for ICS components: hardening, patch management, remote access controls, and network separation.

objects.title: Remote Access for ICS
objects.description: Secure remote access to industrial systems: authentication, encrypted tunnels, session monitoring, and vendor access controls.
